text:
Nora - People Ops: Quick check 3 Ethan is asking whether we can combine a team-to-team transfer with an immediate promotion + one-time retention bonus for Priya. Need to confirm approvals, payroll impact, and whether we can short-circuit the normal 72-hr packet requirement.
CompBot: Policy snapshot: Transfers do not auto-trigger comp changes. Standard packet must be in 72 hrs before committee meeting for non-expedited reviews. Expedited review available for retention/external offers; target 1-2 business days.
Ethan - Eng Manager: Priya has an external offer and wants title/comp aligned on transfer day. Budget on receiving team is tight; thinking base increase if possible and add a spot bonus funded from my team's budget.
Priya - IC: Would prefer base increase + title. If not possible immediately, spot bonus helps but I'd prefer the promotion be effective same day for internal recognition.
Nora - People Ops: Practical steps: 1) Submit Comp-Change packet with "expedite - retention" checked and attach offer letter. 2) Include manager justification (3 bullets), 2 peer calibrations, proposed funding code for spot bonus if any. 3) DM comp-chair link after submission. Committee can approve same-day effective dates as long as approvals complete before payroll cutoff.
Sam - Rewards: Note on equity: promotions do not automatically shift vesting schedules or refresh timing. If you want an off-cycle equity grant, mark "equity request" in the packet; that triggers a separate Rewards review.
Ethan - Eng Manager: If the committee approves the promotion but not full base bump, can we structure partial immediate increase + guaranteed review in 6 months?
Nora - People Ops: Yes; committee can approve phased increases. Document the planned future step and funding source. If cumulative change exceeds 20% we need Finance+budget owner approval. For "in-band" <=10% we can approve quickly. 10-20% goes to Comp Chair.
Priya - IC: About backdating: can effective date be the transfer date even if payroll has passed?
Nora - People Ops: If approvals happen after payroll cutoff, we process retro pay on the next cycle. We avoid backdates beyond 30 days for audit reasons. You can request retro pay but include explanation for backdate in the packet.
Ethan - Eng Manager: What qualifies as "sufficient evidence" for expedite? A signed offer plus two peer bullets?
CompBot: Expedited evidence typical checklist: signed external offer OR documented retention risk, manager note (3 bullets), 2 peer calibrations, and proposed comp numbers. Missing items may delay triage.
Sam - Rewards: Also call out if transfer crosses legal entities (US -> EU) since taxes and benefits may delay effective date and require legal/benefits sign-off.
Priya - IC: Thanks. If we get approval and effective date aligns, will my title change immediately in org chart/tools?
Nora - People Ops: Yes, we update HRIS/title fields once approvals are finalized; expect 24-48 hrs for system propagation. Equity/off-cycle grants are separate.
Ethan - Eng Manager: I'll assemble the packet and mark expedite. Nora, I'll DM the packet link after submission.
Nora - People Ops: Great 3 I'll ping the Chair. TL;DR: stacking transfer+promo allowed, submit expedite packet with offer and peer calibs, >20% needs Finance, backdates beyond 30 days discouraged, equity separate. :white_check_mark:
